stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: The young trees suffer during the long drought.
items.sentenceZh: 幼树在长期干旱中受损。
items.scene: A row of young orchard trees visibly suffers during prolonged drought: leaves droop and curl, dry soil cracks and a nearly empty irrigation channel runs beside them. An adult grower carefully adds limited water to the weakest tree, showing concern without human injury or distress spectacle.
items.altText: 长期干旱使幼树叶片下垂、土壤开裂，种植者给最弱的树补水。

items.sentenceEn: She gives a speech to the community.
items.sentenceZh: 她向社区发表演讲。
items.scene: One adult speaker stands at a plain podium and delivers a speech to a small seated community audience. Her open gesture, focused expression and the listeners' shared attention make spoken public address clear. The podium and backdrop contain no writing or symbols.
items.altText: 一名演讲者站在无字讲台后向社区听众讲话。

items.sentenceEn: Their wetland restoration is successful.
items.sentenceZh: 他们的湿地修复取得了成功。
items.scene: Three adult ecologists stand beside a restored wetland where newly planted reeds thrive, clear water flows and birds have returned. They compare the healthy site with one small earlier photograph card showing bare mud, then celebrate the successful result with relieved smiles.
items.altText: 生态人员在恢复生机的湿地旁查看早期荒地照片，并为成功修复而微笑。

items.sentenceEn: She considers two options for crossing the river.
items.sentenceZh: 她考虑两种过河选择。
items.scene: An adult traveler stands at a river crossing with exactly two safe options clearly visible: a small passenger ferry at one dock and a pedestrian bridge nearby. She looks between the two while holding a plain map with no labels.
items.altText: 旅行者在渡船和人行桥两种安全过河方式之间进行考虑。

items.sentenceEn: Each participant builds a small clay bowl.
items.sentenceZh: 每位参与者都制作一个小陶碗。
items.scene: At an adult pottery workshop, one foreground participant actively shapes a clay bowl at the shared table while an instructor demonstrates and two other participants work on their own bowls. Matching aprons and hands-on activity establish everyone as a participant rather than spectator.
items.altText: 陶艺工作坊中，一名参与者在共用桌旁亲手塑造陶碗。

items.sentenceEn: The southern coast of the island is warm and green.
items.sentenceZh: 岛屿的南部海岸温暖而翠绿。
items.scene: An adult geographer studies a north-up relief model of one island. A simple compass arrow points upward with no letters; the opposite lower coast is sunlit, warm and green while the upper coast is cool and rocky. She points specifically to the lower southern coast.
items.altText: 地理学家在上北下南的岛屿地形模型上指出温暖翠绿的南部海岸。

items.meaningZh: 新鲜的；清新的；新奇的；淡的
items.sentenceEn: The farmer brings fresh vegetables from the field.
items.sentenceZh: 农民从田里带来新鲜蔬菜。
items.scene: At sunrise, an adult farmer carries a just-harvested basket of crisp leafy greens, carrots and tomatoes from the field. Dew remains on the leaves, loose soil clings to roots and the nearby plants show where the vegetables were freshly picked.
items.altText: 清晨，农民从田里带来带露珠和少量泥土的刚采收蔬菜。

items.sentenceEn: The seed eventually grows into a fruit tree.
items.sentenceZh: 这颗种子最终长成一棵果树。
items.scene: A single continuous left-to-right seasonal sequence shows exactly four stages in the same garden bed: planted seed, small sprout, young sapling and eventually one mature fruit-bearing tree. Subtle changes from spring to late summer communicate that the final result takes time.
items.altText: 同一花圃从左到右依次呈现种子、嫩芽、幼树和最终结果实的成树。

items.sentenceEn: A dense forest covers the mountain valley.
items.sentenceZh: 茂密森林覆盖着山谷。
items.scene: A broad temperate forest fills a mountain valley with layered canopy, tall trunks, shaded understory, ferns, moss and a narrow stream. A tiny adult ranger on the trail provides scale while the connected expanse of trees remains the unmistakable subject.
items.altText: 层层树冠、苔藓、蕨类和溪流组成茂密的山谷森林。

items.meaningZh: 影像；电视；图像的；电视的
items.sentenceEn: They record a video of the pottery lesson.
items.sentenceZh: 他们录制陶艺课的视频。
items.scene: An adult camera operator records an adult potter demonstrating a wheel-thrown bowl. A flip-out camera screen visibly shows the same live composition inside its frame, making moving video capture clear, while one assistant monitors sound with plain equipment.
items.altText: 摄像者录制陶艺示范，摄像机翻转屏中显示同一实时画面。

items.sentenceEn: Satellites provide a global view of the weather.
items.sentenceZh: 卫星提供全球天气视图。
items.scene: A full illustrated Earth floats against space with several weather systems visible across different oceans and continents. Three small unbranded observation satellites orbit around the entire globe, emphasizing worldwide coverage rather than one region.
items.altText: 完整地球上可见多个大陆和天气系统，三颗卫星环绕全球观测。

items.sentenceEn: The Senate debates the proposed law.
items.sentenceZh: 参议院就拟议法律展开辩论。
items.scene: Inside a fictional non-national upper legislative chamber, adult senators sit at curved rows of individual desks while one senator speaks from the central floor and a presiding officer listens above. No flags, parties, seals, real politicians, national colors or readable documents.
items.altText: 虚构的参议院议事厅中，参议员分坐弧形席位并听取中央发言。

items.sentenceEn: The city reforms its bus network.
items.sentenceZh: 这座城市改革公交网络。
items.scene: Adult transit planners replace a tangled old tabletop route model with a redesigned network of clear connected routes, frequent transfer hubs and better neighborhood coverage. Exactly two side-by-side models show the flawed system before and the improved system after, without maps containing text.
items.altText: 交通规划者把混乱的旧公交模型改造成线路清晰、覆盖更广的新网络。

items.sentenceEn: The new ramp gives everyone access to the library.
items.sentenceZh: 新坡道让所有人都能进入图书馆。
items.scene: A wide gently sloped ramp with handrails leads directly to an open public-library entrance beside existing stairs. An adult wheelchair user and an adult pushing a stroller move easily up the ramp while the doorway remains clearly reachable.
items.altText: 带扶手的缓坡通向开放的图书馆入口，轮椅使用者和推婴儿车者顺利进入。

items.sentenceEn: The restaurant serves dinner to its guests.
items.sentenceZh: 这家餐馆为客人供应晚餐。
items.scene: A welcoming neighborhood restaurant shows several adult guests seated at separate dining tables, one server carrying plated meals and an open pass revealing cooks working in the kitchen. Table service, dining room and kitchen together establish the restaurant.
items.altText: 餐馆中客人分桌用餐，服务员送上餐点，开放窗口后厨师正在工作。

items.sentenceEn: The judge compares the three handmade bowls.
items.sentenceZh: 评委比较三个手工陶碗。
items.scene: At a craft exhibition, one adult judge carefully compares exactly three handmade ceramic bowls on a plain display table, inspecting glaze and shape with a small magnifier. Three adult makers wait nearby while the judge places one simple ribbon beside the selected bowl.
items.altText: 工艺展评委仔细比较三个手工陶碗，并把一枚素色奖花放在选中的碗旁。

items.sentenceEn: The small press publishes her first book.
items.sentenceZh: 这家小型出版社出版了她的第一本书。
items.scene: Inside a small printing workshop, an adult press operator lifts newly bound copies from a production table and hands the first finished book to its adult author. A printing press, stacks of identical blank-covered books and packing boxes show the work being published.
items.altText: 印刷工把刚装订好的第一本书交给作者，后方有印刷机和成摞成书。

items.sentenceEn: The model shows the relation between rainfall and river level.
items.sentenceZh: 模型展示降雨量与河流水位之间的关系。
items.scene: An adult science educator demonstrates a split watershed model: on one side light rain feeds a low narrow river, and on the other heavy rain feeds a visibly higher wider river. Matching channels connect rainfall to water level, revealing the relation without graphs or labels.
items.altText: 流域模型对比小雨下的低水位和大雨下的高水位，显示两者联系。

items.sentenceEn: The caretakers release the healed turtle into the sea.
items.sentenceZh: 护理人员把康复的海龟放归大海。
items.scene: At a quiet beach, two adult wildlife caretakers open a low transport crate and gently allow one healthy sea turtle to crawl freely toward the water. Their hands remain back as the animal leaves, clearly showing release without restraint or injury.
items.altText: 护理人员打开运输箱，让一只康复海龟自由爬向海水。

items.sentenceEn: A bright bird waits above the stream.
items.sentenceZh: 一只鲜艳的鸟停在溪流上方。
items.scene: One vividly colored kingfisher perches sideways on a branch above a clear stream. Its beak, feathers, folded wings, two feet and alert eye are accurately visible, with soft woodland habitat behind and no other birds.
items.altText: 一只色彩鲜艳的翠鸟停在溪流上方树枝上，羽毛、喙和双足清晰可见。
